data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net calendar year claims incurred of $106,371,000 (2022: $75,625,000) is a deterioration of $10,197,000 in claims reserves established at the prior year end (2022: deterioration $10,434,000).
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1971 experienced a strengthening of prior year reserves by $10.197 million in 2023. This deterioration was attributed to a loading for inflation, a margin added over actuarial best estimates, and assumptions underlying the reserving methodology reflecting additional information from pricing current and prospective business, impacting the 2020 and prior years of account.
raw_causal_phrases: loading for inflation and a margin added over and above actuarial best estimates
assumptions underlying our reserving methodology reflect additional information obtained from pricing current and prospective business
back year deterioration on the 2020 and prior years of account
data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is explicitly stated in Note 6. While the phrasing 'Included within net calendar year claims incurred... is a deterioration of $10,197,000' suggests a net figure, it is the most direct quantification of prior year reserve movement available. The gross claims development triangle on page 20 indicates a gross strengthening of $17.675m for years 2019-2021, but this is a calculation and the explicit narrative is prioritized. RITC activity for prior years (2019, 2020, 2021) may also distort the claims development triangle.
